item.text: {"summary":"Draft is broadly publishable against the target contract, but the interval support should be strengthened because it rests on only three recent monthly changes.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The 80% interval is justified from a sample sigma computed on only three February-May 2026 month-to-month changes, including a fuel-shock reversal period, which is a thin basis for realized volatility.","actionRequested":"Either broaden the historical volatility sample for Monthly CPI Indicator annual-rate changes or explicitly state why the three-change shock-window sample is sufficient for the July 2026 first print."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +0.2 net movement above the 4.0 persistence prior is plausible but only loosely tied to cited evidence; the component adjustments are mostly qualitative.","actionRequested":"Tie each material adjustment to a cited official or clearly identified public datum, or reduce the claimed precision of the adjustment components."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Keep the ledger discrepancy note; it correctly preserves the target identity while flagging the sourceBinding mismatch.","Consider replacing tabloid/news citations with official ABS/RBA sources where available, since the resolver and evidence base are official-series focused.","State explicitly that June 2026 is not used because it was not yet available at run time, if that is true."]}
